title: Smokepowder Bomb
summary: A thrown bomb that explodes on impact for 3d4 + 9 Force.

fields.Throw: Action, 60 ft, 13 ft radius. DC 12 Dexterity save halves 3d4 + 9 Force. Automatically crits objects and environments.
fields.Acquisition: Sold by multiple traders and carried by some goblins. No alchemy recipe.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
